description: Fix all 10 P0 Critical Issues identified in the code audit. These are security vulnerabilities, correctness bugs, and performance problems that must be resolved before production.
steps: SEC-C1: In apps/backend/app/config.py, add to the validate_production_secrets method a check that rejects known placeholder JWT secrets. Add a set of KNOWN_PLACEHOLDER_SECRETS = {'super_secret_jwt_key_32_chars_min', 'CHANGE_ME_IN_PRODUCTION_AT_LEAST_32_CHARS_LONG', 'test-secret-at-least-32-characters-long'} and raise ValueError if JWT_SECRET matches any of them in production mode.

SEC-C2: In apps/edge/src/index.ts, modify the Turnstile bot protection section (lines 44-51) to make Turnstile verification MANDATORY for auth endpoints (/api/v1/auth/signup, /api/v1/auth/login, /api/v1/auth/forgot-password). If the CF-Turnstile-Response header is missing for these paths, return a 403 JSON error. Keep it optional for chat endpoints.

SEC-C5: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/auth.py, implement refresh token revocation using Redis. (a) Add a 'jti' (JWT ID) claim using uuid4 to create_refresh_token(). (b) When a refresh token is used in the /refresh endpoint, store the old jti in Redis with key 'revoked_token:{jti}' and TTL matching REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRY_DAYS. (c) Before processing a refresh, check Redis for the jti - if found, reject the token. (d) Issue a new refresh token with a new jti on each refresh. Use the existing get_redis() from app.db.redis.

CHAT-C1: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/chat.py, fix both the streaming and non-streaming endpoints to use sanitized_message for all LLM calls. In the non-streaming endpoint (around line 120), change 'user_message=request.message' to 'user_message=sanitized_message'. In the streaming endpoint's event_stream() generator (around line 207), change 'user_message=request.message' to 'user_message=sanitized_message'. Also fix the fallback path (around line 216) from 'request.message' to 'sanitized_message'.

RAG-C1: In apps/backend/app/config.py, add a new config field: AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT: Optional[str] = None (in the Azure Search section). In apps/backend/app/services/ai/embedder.py, change the URL from settings.AZURE_SEARCH_ENDPOINT to settings.AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT. Add a guard at the top of generate_embedding: if not settings.AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT, raise RuntimeError('AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT not configured').

API-C2: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/health.py, remove the prefix='/health' from the router definition (line 11), changing it to router = APIRouter(tags=['Health']). This way the include_router calls in main.py that already provide prefix='/health' and prefix='/api/health' will result in correct paths: /health (basic), /health/deep, /api/health, /api/health/deep.

PAY-C1: In apps/backend/app/api/webhooks/razorpay.py, add idempotency checking at the start of handle_razorpay_webhook. After signature verification and event parsing, extract event_id = event.get('id'). Use Redis to check if this event was already processed: key = f'webhook_processed:{event_id}'. If key exists, return {'status': 'duplicate', 'event_id': event_id}. After successful processing, set the key with TTL of 7 days (604800 seconds).

PAY-C3: In apps/backend/app/services/comms/resend_client.py, wrap the synchronous resend.Emails.send() calls in asyncio.get_event_loop().run_in_executor(None, ...) to avoid blocking the async event loop. Import asyncio at the top. Change each resend.Emails.send(params) call to: await asyncio.get_event_loop().run_in_executor(None, resend.Emails.send, params).

OBS-C1: In apps/backend/app/main.py, fix the PostHog initialization (around line 56) to store the instance on app.state instead of a local variable. Change '_posthog = Posthog(...)' to 'app.state.posthog = Posthog(...)'. This requires passing the app reference. Since we are inside the lifespan context manager which yields to the app, store it by referencing the app parameter directly. Add 'app.state.posthog = None' before the if-block, then assign inside.

PERF-C1: In apps/backend/app/services/ai/embedder.py, replace the per-request httpx.AsyncClient creation with a module-level singleton. Create '_http_client: httpx.AsyncClient | None = None' and a 'get_http_client()' function that lazily initializes it. Use this client in generate_embedding() instead of 'async with httpx.AsyncClient(...)'. Add a 'close_http_client()' async function for shutdown. In apps/backend/app/main.py, import and call close_http_client() in the shutdown phase of lifespan.
acceptance_criteria: config.py rejects known placeholder JWT secrets in production mode with a ValueError
Edge worker returns 403 when CF-Turnstile-Response header is missing on /api/v1/auth/signup, /api/v1/auth/login, and /api/v1/auth/forgot-password
Refresh tokens include a jti claim and used jtis are stored in Redis for revocation
Both streaming and non-streaming chat endpoints pass sanitized_message to LLM calls
Embedder uses AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT config variable instead of AZURE_SEARCH_ENDPOINT
Health check paths resolve correctly: /health returns 200, not /health/health
Razorpay webhook checks Redis for duplicate event IDs before processing
Resend email sends are wrapped in run_in_executor to avoid blocking
PostHog instance stored in app.state.posthog, accessible throughout the application
Embedder uses a singleton httpx.AsyncClient instead of creating one per request
verification: Run: python -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('apps/backend/app/config.py').read()); ast.parse(open('apps/backend/app/main.py').read()); ast.parse(open('apps/backend/app/api/v1/auth.py').read()); ast.parse(open('apps/backend/app/api/v1/chat.py').read()); ast.parse(open('apps/backend/app/api/v1/health.py').read()); ast.parse(open('apps/backend/app/api/webhooks/razorpay.py').read()); ast.parse(open('apps/backend/app/services/comms/resend_client.py').read()); ast.parse(open('apps/backend/app/services/ai/embedder.py').read()); print('All files parse OK')"
Run: npx tsc --noEmit --project apps/edge/tsconfig.json to verify TypeScript compiles
Run: APP_ENV=test JWT_SECRET=test_secret_that_is_at_least_32_characters_long pytest apps/backend/tests/ -v to verify existing tests still pass
findings: All 10 P0 fixes implemented and verified. Python AST parsing confirms all files are syntactically valid. TypeScript compiles cleanly (only pre-existing error in bot.ts unrelated to changes). Test suite: 32 tests pass, 5 pre-existing failures (4 webhook tests fail due to double-prefix on razorpay router - tests hit /api/webhooks/razorpay but actual path is /api/webhooks/webhooks/razorpay because razorpay.py router has prefix=/webhooks AND main.py uses prefix=/api/webhooks; 1 auth test fails due to Beanie ODM not initialized without MongoDB). Health endpoint confirmed working at /health and /api/health after prefix fix.
